items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Manuel Perez was the house band. Yeah. And the place, to claim there, a crowd of 2,100 people up there... they had his band, Piran band over there, and Manuel Perez band.

ctx.x: Do you ever remember him taking these solos, you know, drum solos?

I don't remember the kind of old man knows. He might have did it, you know, because they was working mostly on these nightclub jobs, like at Spanish Folk, and one night they pull a big dance at the place they call the Temple Roof Garden, and they had his band, Piran band over there, and Manuel Perez band. Manuel Perez was the house band. Yeah. And the place, to claim there, a crowd of 2,100 people up there, that's a large crowd for a place like that. Did you? He could even have, all the heads standing room in…
You know they do drum tags on the end of things now? Yeah. Did he ever do anything like that? Did he ever do anything like that? Did he ever do anything like that? Did he ever do it?
